summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K to furnish a press release announcing the deployment of its RAD ROSA security solution at a VIP parking facility in Kansas City during the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The filing is informational under Item 8.01 and 9.01, with no material corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The 8-K is a routine current report, not triggering a special-situation classification.
